Ooredoo الجزائر تجدّد التزامها التضامني: Ooredoo Algeria renews its solidarity commitment by organizing a blood donation campaign
تجسيدًا لالتزامها المتواصل في مجال المسؤ: Embodying its ongoing commitment to corporate social responsibility, Ooredoo Algeria organized, on Monday, November 23, 2026, in collaboration with the National Blood Agency, its third blood donation drive for employees this year, held simultaneously at its three headquarters in Algiers, Oran, and Constantine.
أضحت هذه المبادرة تقليدًا راسخًا ضمن است: This initiative has become a firmly established tradition within the company's strategy and its enduring commitment to corporate social responsibility. This new campaign reflects Ooredoo's dedication to instilling a culture of voluntary blood donation and raising awareness among its employees about the importance of this noble humanitarian act that contributes to saving lives.
أشرف على هذه العملية طاقم طبي تابع للمؤس: The operation was supervised by a medical team from the "El Tayeb Boukacem" Public Hospital Establishment in Zeralda, in coordination with Ooredoo's occupational health teams and representatives of the National Blood Agency. The initiative took place in the presence of the General Manager of the National Blood Agency, Professor Issam Feriga, the Director of Corporate Affairs, Media Relations, and Corporate Social Responsibility, Mr. Ramdane Djazairi, as well as the Acting Human Resources Director of Ooredoo, Mrs. Nesrine Rahal.
يجدر الذكر إلى أن Ooredoo الجزائر نظّمت: It is worth noting that Ooredoo Algeria has organized two blood donation campaigns since the beginning of the current year, in April and July 2026, thereby reflecting the spirit of commitment and solidarity demonstrated by Ooredoo employees and their constant eagerness to actively contribute to solidarity and humanitarian initiatives.
من خلال هذه المبادرة الجديدة، تؤكد Oored: Through this new initiative, Ooredoo Algeria reaffirms its commitment as a corporate citizen, its adherence to the values of responsibility, sharing, and mutual support, and its continued contribution to supporting efforts aimed at anchoring a culture of solidarity and mutual aid in society.
